note: Wording of six items transcribed verbatim from Table 1 of the main article (the S1 Appendix, pone.0276082.s001 sha256 213e6cce..., does NOT list this block); '1.'..'6.' numbering and '(Item N)' labels stripped. Table 1 is sorted by % agreeing and its (Item N) labels are rank positions, not codes: Item 1 = COVCONS_3, Item 2 = COVCONS_2, Item 3 = COVCONS_4, Item 4 = COVCONS_7, Item 5 = COVCONS_6, Item 6 = COVCONS_5. Codes: data/enders_2022_conspiracy_vaccine.py keeps the Qualtrics column names; Raw Data.csv has no question-text row and no codebook. The study's Analyses.do renames covcons_1..7 as cexaggerate, cpurpose, deaths, covidvaxx, cellphone, billgates, tracking and builds the published scale as alpha cpurpose-tracking (= COVCONS_2..7). Checked against the data independently of those names: dropping COVCONS_1 is the only 6-item subset reproducing the published alpha .90 / M 2.20 / SD 1.04 (2.1987/1.0419/0.9039), and live % resp>=4 for COVCONS_2..7 (24.878/28.996/20.419/9.211/11.008/12.275) rounds to Table 1's 25/29/20/9/11/12 under exactly one of 720 assignments, the shipped one. COVCONS_1 (7th item, do-file name cexaggerate, 25.475% agree, outside the published scale) has no wording in the article, the S1 Appendix, the README or the deposit, so its item_text is blank; a similar 'threat of coronavirus has been exaggerated by political groups who want to damage President Trump' item appears in other Uscinski-team surveys (e.g. PLOS ONE e0270429) but nothing ties it to this column, so it was not used. No instructions/stem for this block are published, so instructions is blank (the sibling tables' 'Please tell us how much you agree or disagree' stem was not carried over). Options: only the Table 1 footnote names responses ('agree' and 'strongly agree'); they are placed on resp 4 and 5, confirmed as the pair by the >=4 cut reproducing all six percentages, with 5 = strongly agree by ascending convention; resp 1-3 left blank (no labels published). Rights: study-authored items (Uscinski/Enders team), printed in a CC BY article; no instrument_rights_register.csv row applies (ACTS/GCBS/CMQ rows are other instruments) and no restriction was found to quote, so extracted normally; no register row written.
